title: Traveling with a Tight Budget
paragraphs: Aji wants to see more of his country without spending much money. He plans a one-week trip. He uses public buses and cheap guesthouses, not flights and hotels.
The trip is slow and sometimes not comfortable. Aji waits a long time at bus stations. His rooms are simple, but the trip costs very little.
On the trip, Aji meets other travelers with small budgets. They share ideas about cheap local food places. The food becomes one of his best memories.
At the end of the week, Aji learns something. A small budget helps him talk more with local people and see places that many tourists do not see.
